designs.title: How to Go to Bed
designs.why: As a dog owner I laughed out loud: my dog does exactly this, and the four 'Turn around.' lines plus '7. Sigh.' is the joke done perfectly. It's warm, not snarky, and the loose brush dogs are charming. It reads as a cute grid of dogs from across the room, and the joke lands once you're close enough to read the captions. I'd buy it on black. Small gripes: the twisting dogs in steps 4 and 5 are a bit tangled (legs and tail are hard to follow), and on the tee the captions get pretty small for a $50 shirt.
designs.fix: Make the step 4 and 5 drawings clearer so the dog obviously reads as spinning in place (cleaner head, tail and legs, fewer overlapping strokes), and set the captions a bit bigger so the joke reads from a few steps away.
